text: Visitors have noted issues with the timed entry system, particularly confusion about when they can enter after their scheduled time and long lines during certain periods. Some found the check-in process with wristbands and kiosks cumbersome. There were multiple comments about crowding, especially in the early immersive rooms, which some found tight and uncomfortable. A number of reviews criticized the use of AI in exhibits, feeling it was inappropriate or excessive. Food and beverage options received negative feedback regarding quality and wait times.
